emails.subject: Night shift briefing - Wed 11/18
emails.body:
Casey,

First solo night. You'll be fine. Gary's old notes are in Documents if you want them.

Tonight's work is in your Work Queue. Do the items in order:

1. ARCHIVE: drag finished files from Intake onto the Archive folder.
2. WORK ORDERS: before you approve a drive wipe, look up the owner's employee number in Personnel. Approve ONLY if their status is TERMINATED. Anything else, reject.
3. JUNK: drag temp files onto the Disposal bin and confirm. Shredding is permanent.

Don't open the .dat files. The Data Viewer is for integrity checks only.

Custodial starts rounds on B-Level around 3:00. Stay seated while they're through.

Shift ends at 7:00 AM. Log off before you leave. If WS-04 goes down before then, go home and I will sort it out.

Ruth Hale
Night Operations Supervisor

emails.subject: Reminder: B-Level doors
emails.body:
Reminder to all B-Level night staff:

Office doors on B-Level are to remain CLOSED during the night shift.

If you return to your office and find the door open, do not close it. Note the time and report it to Facilities in the morning.

Do not prop doors open, and do not stand in doorways during Custodial rounds.

Door behavior on B-Level is related to air balancing and is not a security concern.

Harold Whitcomb
Facilities

emails.subject: Camera Viewer access (policy change)
emails.body:
Effective today, the Camera Viewer on operator workstations is restricted to Security staff. Operators will see ACCESS DENIED. This is expected.

B-Level is monitored at all times for your safety.

- CAM 04 is offline pending repair.
- CAM 03 is functioning as intended. Please stop submitting tickets about CAM 03.

Leonard Brandt
Security Supervisor

emails.subject: Night rounds - what to expect
emails.body:
New night staff:

Custodial Services completes rounds on B-Level each night, beginning around 3:00 AM.

Custodial personnel do not converse. Please do not greet, question, or follow them, and do not obstruct their route.

During rounds, remain seated at your workstation and continue working. If Custodial enters your office, do not turn around. They will leave when they are finished.

Thank you for helping us keep Letheworth clean.

emails.subject: Reclaimed records: operator FAQ
emails.body:
Q: What is on the drives?
A: Legacy customer and business records from accounts that have lapsed.

Q: May I open them?
A: No. The Data Viewer is for integrity checks only.

Q: A record did not respond to the integrity check.
A: Flag it QUIET. Most records are quiet.

Q: A QUIET record has started to respond.
A: Clear the flag. File it with Retention.

Q: A file will not shred.
A: Some records are persistent. Keep trying. Report persistent records to the Office of Retention.

Q: A file has moved on its own.
A: Files do not move on their own. Report the operator.

Office of Retention

emails.subject: welcome + Gary's stuff
emails.body:
Hi Casey!

Welcome to the night crew, officially. You're in Gary's old chair, so if you find any of his stuff (mug with the ducks on it, a paperback, reading glasses) there's a box at reception.

Nobody's heard from him. HR says "extended leave." His car was in the lot for a week, and then it wasn't.

Anyway. Don't drink the coffee on B. Call me if you need anything. I'm day shift but I'm up late.

Denise

P.S. If Joan Nakamura's name comes through your queue (Accounts, she runs the coffee fund), go easy on it. Her review is Friday and she's been a wreck about it.

emails.subject: handover
emails.body:
To whoever gets WS-04 next:

My notes are in Documents. Sorry, they got messy at the end.

Take your breaks. Don't open the .dat files. If your door opens, leave it.

If the mouse acts up, don't fight it too hard.

- G

emails.subject: Scheduled maintenance: input irregularities
emails.body:
Hi all,

We're aware of input irregularities on some B-Level workstations: cursors jumping, files selecting themselves, a window shifting a few pixels, phantom clicks.

This is a known fault in the older pointing-device driver and is not caused by anything you did. A patch is scheduled for Saturday.

In the meantime:
- Do not unplug your mouse.
- Do not restart your workstation.
- If the pointer moves on its own, take your hand off the mouse and let it finish. Do not fight it unless a task in your Work Queue tells you to.

Please do NOT report irregularities on WS-04. They are already logged.

Thanks,
Victor Pell
Information Systems

emails.subject: URGENT: employee_017.dat - shred immediately
emails.body:
PRIORITY ORDER - OFFICE OF RETENTION

A persistent record, employee_017.dat, has been detected on the WS-04 desktop.

You are instructed to SHRED this file immediately.

- Do not open it.
- Do not read it.
- Do not move it anywhere except the Disposal bin.
- Do not discuss it with other staff.
- If it types to you, do not reply.

This order supersedes all other work. Your supervisor has been notified.

A. Voss
Director of Retention

emails.subject: Re: employee_017.dat
emails.body:
Casey,

Retention says the file is still on your desktop.

I know. It does that. It did it to Gary too. Drag it to the bin and try it a few times, and do not open it. If it will not go, stop: nobody can shred it while another session holds it. Let it finish, and watch.

Retention will tell you not to answer it. If it types to you, answer it in Jotter. I would rather you knew what it wants.

Custodial is coming down to B-Level early tonight. I have noted that I checked in on you at 2:21 AM.

Ruth
